research_question: Can Kernal provide durable mounted storage and pseudo-filesystem semantics while preserving capability and protected-storage isolation?

metrics.name: crypto_overhead_percent
metrics.condition: record when protected secure-storage path is active

metrics.name: compartment_isolation_failures
metrics.condition: import from canonical secure-storage evidence when active

metrics.name: integrity_detections
metrics.condition: import from canonical secure-storage evidence when active

metrics.name: wrong_key_rejections
metrics.condition: import from canonical secure-storage evidence when active

negative_controls: stale file/volume handles must fail generation revalidation
selected crash points must never produce silent unauthenticated recovery
persistent-volume encryption evidence must not be described as per-address-space RAM encryption

repetition_policy.timing_metrics: report distribution, variance, block size and queue depth

promotion_rule.to_measured: exact-SHA executed evidence must cover VFS/durability negatives and any active secure-storage metrics; hard-zero metrics must be zero
promotion_rule.to_replicated: independent reproduction of the pinned rootfs/storage profile is required
